FROM python:3.10-slim

ENV PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
ENV PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers
ENV PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=0

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    libnss3 libnspr4 libdbus-1-3 libatk1.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libcups2 libdrm2 \
    libgbm1 libatspi2.0-0 libx11-6 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxext6 libxfixes3 \
    libxrandr2 libxkbcommon0 libpango-1.0-0 libcairo2 libasound2 \
    fonts-liberation \
    wget \
    ca-certificates \
    && apt-get clean \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .

RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

RUN playwright install --with-deps chromium

COPY . .

ENV TARGET_URL="https://www.pajacyk.pl/"
ENV CLICK_SELECTOR=".pajacyk__clickbox"
ENV SUCCESS_SELECTOR=".pajacyk__thankyou"
ENV COUNT_SPAN_SELECTOR="main > p > span"
ENV WAIT_TIMEOUT="20"
ENV MAX_CONCURRENCY="10"

CMD ["python", "pajacyk_clicker.py"]

================
File: pajacyk_clicker.py
================
import time
import logging
import os
import random
import sys
import asyncio
import signal

from playwright.async_api import (
    async_playwright,
    TimeoutError as PlaywrightTimeoutError,
    Error as PlaywrightError
)

TARGET_URL = os.getenv('TARGET_URL', "https://www.pajacyk.pl/")
CLICK_ELEMENT_SELECTOR = os.getenv('CLICK_SELECTOR', ".pajacyk__clickbox")
SUCCESS_ELEMENT_SELECTOR = os.getenv('SUCCESS_SELECTOR', ".pajacyk__thankyou")
COUNT_SPAN_SELECTOR = os.getenv('COUNT_SPAN_SELECTOR', "main > p > span")
WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS = int(os.getenv('WAIT_TIMEOUT', "20")) * 1000
SHORT_TIMEOUT_MS = 5000
MAX_CONCURRENT_CYCLES = int(os.getenv('MAX_CONCURRENCY', "10"))

RESOURCE_EXCLUSIONS = [
    "*.jpg", "*.jpeg", "*.png", "*.gif", "*.webp", "*.svg", "*.ico",
    "*.css",
    "*.woff", "*.woff2", "*.ttf", "*.otf",
    "*google-analytics.com*", "*googletagmanager.com*", "*facebook.net*",
    "*youtube.com*", "*ytimg.com*",
]

logging.basicConfig(
    level=logging.INFO,
    # Keep the taskName format specifier
    format='%(asctime)s - %(levelname)s - [%(taskName)s] - %(message)s',
    datefmt='%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'
)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
# Define a default task name for logs outside worker tasks
DEFAULT_TASK_NAME = "MAIN"

abort_event = asyncio.Event()

def handle_signal():
    # Use extra to add taskName context to this log
    logger.warning("Abort signal received! Finishing active cycles...", extra={'taskName': 'SIGNAL'})
    abort_event.set()

async def perform_one_cycle(browser, semaphore, cycle_num):
    # Set the task name for logs generated within this function's context
    task_name = f"Cycle-{cycle_num}"
    asyncio.current_task().set_name(task_name)
    # Pass task_name via extra for robustness, though set_name should often suffice
    log_extra = {'taskName': task_name}

    context = None
    page = None
    click_successful = False
    verification_successful = False
    extracted_count = "N/A"
    cycle_start_time = time.monotonic()

    async with semaphore:
        if abort_event.is_set():
             logger.info(f"Cycle {cycle_num} cancelled before start.", extra=log_extra)
             return False, "Aborted"

        logger.debug(f"Semaphore acquired, starting cycle {cycle_num}", extra=log_extra)
        try:
            context = await browser.new_context(
                viewport={'width': 1280, 'height': 720},
                user_agent='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/115.0.0.0 Safari/537.36',
                java_script_enabled=True,
                accept_downloads=False,
                bypass_csp=True
            )

            for pattern in RESOURCE_EXCLUSIONS:
                try:
                    await context.route(pattern, lambda route: route.abort())
                except Exception as e_route:
                    logger.error(f"Error setting up route for pattern '{pattern}': {e_route}", extra=log_extra)
            logger.debug(f"Resource blocking routes configured.", extra=log_extra)

            page = await context.new_page()
            logger.debug(f"New page created.", extra=log_extra)

            logger.debug(f"Navigating to {TARGET_URL}...", extra=log_extra)
            await page.goto(TARGET_URL, wait_until='domcontentloaded', timeout=WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS + 5000)
            logger.debug("Navigation complete.", extra=log_extra)

            click_locator = page.locator(CLICK_ELEMENT_SELECTOR)
            logger.debug(f"Waiting for click element: {CLICK_ELEMENT_SELECTOR}", extra=log_extra)
            await click_locator.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS)
            logger.debug("Click element visible.", extra=log_extra)

            logger.debug("Attempting click...", extra=log_extra)
            await click_locator.click(timeout=10000)
            click_successful = True
            logger.debug("Click action performed.", extra=log_extra)

            success_locator = page.locator(SUCCESS_ELEMENT_SELECTOR)
            logger.debug(f"Waiting for success element: {SUCCESS_ELEMENT_SELECTOR}", extra=log_extra)
            await success_locator.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS)
            verification_successful = True
            logger.debug("Success element visible.", extra=log_extra)

            try:
                count_span_locator = success_locator.locator(COUNT_SPAN_SELECTOR)
                await count_span_locator.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=SHORT_TIMEOUT_MS)
                extracted_count = await count_span_locator.inner_text(timeout=SHORT_TIMEOUT_MS / 2)
                extracted_count = ''.join(filter(str.isdigit, extracted_count))
                logger.debug(f"Successfully extracted count: {extracted_count}", extra=log_extra)
            except PlaywrightTimeoutError:
                logger.warning(f"Could not find/get text from count span ({COUNT_SPAN_SELECTOR}) within {SHORT_TIMEOUT_MS}ms.", extra=log_extra)
                extracted_count = "Timeout"
            except Exception as e_count:
                logger.warning(f"Error extracting count text: {e_count}", extra=log_extra)
                extracted_count = "Error"

        except PlaywrightTimeoutError as e_timeout:
            element_timed_out = CLICK_ELEMENT_SELECTOR if not click_successful else SUCCESS_ELEMENT_SELECTOR
            logger.warning(f"Timeout error waiting for element: {element_timed_out}", extra=log_extra)
        except PlaywrightError as e_playwright:
            err_str = str(e_playwright)
            if "Target page, context or browser has been closed" in err_str:
                 logger.warning(f"Context/Page closed during operation: {err_str}", extra=log_extra)
            elif "net::ERR" in err_str:
                 logger.warning(f"Network error during cycle: {err_str}", extra=log_extra)
            elif "canceled" not in err_str:
                 logger.warning(f"Playwright error during cycle: {e_playwright}", extra=log_extra)
        except Exception as e_general:
            logger.error(f"Unexpected error during cycle: {e_general}", exc_info=False, extra=log_extra)

        finally:
            duration = time.monotonic() - cycle_start_time
            logger.debug(f"Cycle {cycle_num} attempt finished in {duration:.2f}s. Cleaning up...", extra=log_extra)
            if page:
                try: await page.close()
                except Exception: pass
            if context:
                try: await context.close()
                except Exception: pass
            logger.debug(f"Cycle {cycle_num} cleanup complete.", extra=log_extra)

    # Return the original task_name along with results for logging in main
    return verification_successful, extracted_count, task_name


async def main():
    # Define log_extra for main context logs
    main_log_extra = {'taskName': DEFAULT_TASK_NAME}

    browser = None
    playwright_instance = None
    tasks = set()

    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    try:
        loop.add_signal_handler(signal.SIGINT, handle_signal)
        loop.add_signal_handler(signal.SIGTERM, handle_signal)
    except NotImplementedError:
        pass

    logger.info("--- Pajacyk Playwright Clicker Starting (High Throughput Mode v3) ---", extra=main_log_extra)
    logger.info(f"Target URL: {TARGET_URL}", extra=main_log_extra)
    logger.info(f"Max Concurrent Cycles: {MAX_CONCURRENT_CYCLES}", extra=main_log_extra)
    logger.info(f"Resource Blocking Enabled: {len(RESOURCE_EXCLUSIONS)} glob patterns", extra=main_log_extra)
    logger.info("Press Ctrl+C to initiate graceful shutdown.", extra=main_log_extra)

    success_cycles = 0
    failure_cycles = 0
    total_cycles_launched = 0
    start_time = time.time()
    main.last_log_time = start_time # Initialize for periodic logging

    semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(MAX_CONCURRENT_CYCLES)

    try:
        logger.info("Starting Playwright...", extra=main_log_extra)
        playwright_instance = await async_playwright().start()
        logger.info("Launching persistent headless Chromium browser...", extra=main_log_extra)
        browser = await playwright_instance.chromium.launch(
            headless=True,
            args=[
                '--no-sandbox',
                '--disable-dev-shm-usage',
                '--disable-gpu',
                '--window-size=1280,720',
                '--blink-settings=imagesEnabled=false',
                '--disable-features=LazyImageLoading',
                '--disable-background-networking',
            ]
        )
        logger.info("Persistent browser launched successfully.", extra=main_log_extra)

        while not abort_event.is_set():
            if semaphore.locked():
                await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
                continue

            if len(tasks) < MAX_CONCURRENT_CYCLES * 1.5:
                total_cycles_launched += 1
                # Create task for the cycle worker
                task = asyncio.create_task(
                    perform_one_cycle(browser, semaphore, total_cycles_launched)
                )
                tasks.add(task)
                task.add_done_callback(tasks.discard)
                # No need to log launch here, perform_one_cycle start log is better

            if tasks:
                done, pending = await asyncio.wait(tasks, timeout=0.05, return_when=asyncio.FIRST_COMPLETED)

                for task in done:
                    # Default task name if extraction fails
                    cycle_log_extra = {'taskName': 'UNKNOWN'}
                    try:
                        if task.done():
                            # Unpack the result, including the task_name returned by perform_one_cycle
                            cycle_successful, count_value, cycle_task_name = task.result()
                            # Use the correct task name for this log message
                            cycle_log_extra = {'taskName': cycle_task_name}

                            if cycle_successful:
                                success_cycles += 1
                                logger.info(f"Cycle Result SUCCEEDED. Count: {count_value}. [S: {success_cycles}, F: {failure_cycles}]", extra=cycle_log_extra)
                            else:
                                failure_cycles += 1
                                logger.warning(f"Cycle Result FAILED. Result count: {count_value}. [S: {success_cycles}, F: {failure_cycles}]", extra=cycle_log_extra)
                    except asyncio.CancelledError:
                         # Retrieve task name if possible before it's fully cancelled
                         try: cycle_log_extra['taskName'] = task.get_name()
                         except: pass
                         logger.info(f"Task was cancelled.", extra=cycle_log_extra)
                    except Exception as e_task_result:
                         try: cycle_log_extra['taskName'] = task.get_name()
                         except: pass
                         logger.error(f"Error retrieving result for task: {e_task_result}", extra=cycle_log_extra)
                         failure_cycles +=1 # Count as failure
            else:
                 await asyncio.sleep(0.05)

            current_time = time.time()
            elapsed = current_time - start_time
            if current_time - main.last_log_time > 30:
                if elapsed > 0:
                     rate = (success_cycles + failure_cycles) / elapsed if elapsed else 0
                     # Use main_log_extra for this status message
                     logger.info(f"STATUS: Uptime={elapsed:.0f}s, Rate={rate:.2f} cycles/sec, Completed={success_cycles + failure_cycles} [S:{success_cycles}, F:{failure_cycles}], Active Tasks={len(tasks)}", extra=main_log_extra)
                     main.last_log_time = current_time

    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        logger.info("KeyboardInterrupt received, initiating shutdown...", extra=main_log_extra)
        if not abort_event.is_set(): handle_signal()
    except Exception as e_fatal:
        logger.critical(f"Fatal error in main loop or browser launch: {e_fatal}", exc_info=True, extra=main_log_extra)
        if not abort_event.is_set(): abort_event.set()
    finally:
        logger.info("--- Shutdown Sequence Initiated ---", extra=main_log_extra)
        if not abort_event.is_set():
            abort_event.set()

        if tasks:
            logger.info(f"Waiting for {len(tasks)} active cycles to complete or cancel...", extra=main_log_extra)
            try:
                # Gather results (or exceptions) from remaining tasks
                await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True), timeout=WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS/1000 * 2)
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                logger.warning("Timeout waiting for all tasks to finish during shutdown.", extra=main_log_extra)
            except Exception as e_wait:
                 logger.error(f"Error during final task wait: {e_wait}", extra=main_log_extra)
            logger.info("Task shutdown wait complete.", extra=main_log_extra)

        logger.info("Cleaning up browser instance...", extra=main_log_extra)
        if browser:
            try: await browser.close()
            except Exception as e_close: logger.error(f"Error closing main browser: {e_close}", extra=main_log_extra)
        if playwright_instance:
             try: await playwright_instance.stop()
             except Exception as e_stop: logger.error(f"Error stopping Playwright: {e_stop}", extra=main_log_extra)
        logger.info("Playwright stopped.", extra=main_log_extra)

        total_completed = success_cycles + failure_cycles
        final_elapsed = time.time() - start_time
        final_rate = total_completed / final_elapsed if final_elapsed > 0 else 0
        logger.info(f"--- Final Stats ---", extra=main_log_extra)
        logger.info(f"Total Cycles Attempted (Launched): {total_cycles_launched}", extra=main_log_extra)
        logger.info(f"Total Cycles Completed: {total_completed}", extra=main_log_extra)
        logger.info(f"Successful: {success_cycles}", extra=main_log_extra)
        logger.info(f"Failed: {failure_cycles}", extra=main_log_extra)
        logger.info(f"Total Runtime: {final_elapsed:.2f}s", extra=main_log_extra)
        logger.info(f"Average Throughput: {final_rate:.2f} cycles/sec", extra=main_log_extra)

        exit_code = 1 if 'e_fatal' in locals() and not isinstance(e_fatal, KeyboardInterrupt) else 0
        logger.info(f"Exiting with code {exit_code}.", extra=main_log_extra)
        sys.exit(exit_code)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
